caption: The drawing features a rectangular mirror or frame with a double border, the inner and outer borders both outlined in gold. The main section of the rectangle is shaded in pale blue, with the inner area divided into a central rectangular panel and narrower panels at the top, bottom, and sides. Above the rectangle, there is an ornate decorative element in gold, consisting of a central urn with two handles, flanked by symmetrical scrolling vines adorned with small leaves and ending with three hanging tassels on each side. The bottom of the rectangle also has a gold ornamental detail, featuring small scrollwork and a leaf-like centerpiece. The overall composition is placed on a plain, slightly off-white or beige background.
title: Mirror
